concept: A high-end, structural b2b operations console. Marries the precision of Swiss Grid design (essential for data-heavy apps) with an earthy, organic palette suitable for a real-estate/land-developer. Replaces generic SaaS 'college project' aesthetics with a tactical, architectural authority.

headings.usage: All dashboard titles, KPI numbers, and modal headers. Creates an architectural, grounded feel.

body.usage: Standard body copy, form labels, small text.

mono.usage: MANDATORY for all financial numbers (INR ₹), Plot IDs, PO Numbers, and dates. Ensures vertical alignment in tables.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_system: Generous spacing. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Gap-6 between grid items.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento Protocol Mode B (High Density). Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.sidebar: w-64 fixed left-0 top-0 bottom-0 border-r border-[#E5E4E0] bg-white z-40. Contains role-filtered nav.
grids_and_layouts.topbar: h-16 fixed top-0 right-0 left-64 border-b border-[#E5E4E0] bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl z-30 px-8 flex justify-between items-center. DO NOT make it fully transparent.
grids_and_layouts.corners: Rounded-sm (4px) maximum. No pill-shaped cards or 12px radii. Sharp, architectural edges.

Admin.components: 1x Massive KPI (Total Sales Booked) col-span-12 lg:col-span-6. 2x Secondary KPIs (Payments Pending, Procurement Queue) col-span-6 lg:col-span-3 each. Below: Wide Bento tables for 'Recent Activity' and 'Procurement Approvals'.

Post-Sales Rep.components: Top: KPI strip (Available, Sold, Sales Value). Body: Left 2/3 is a dense 'Plot Inventory' table with status pills. Right 1/3 is a sticky 'Quick Action' sidebar containing the 'Mark Sold' form (buyer details, payment schedule generation).
Post-Sales Rep.focus: Speed of marking inventory as sold.

Accounts.components: 90% of screen real estate dedicated to Data Tables. Use JetBrains Mono for all amounts. Top horizontal strip: Pending (Red), Received (Green). Tables: 'Payment Watchlist' and 'Approved Procurements Awaiting PO'.

Site Manager.components: Visual 'Material Inventory' cards showing health bars. Prominent 'Low Stock' alerts in Clay/Terracotta. Right column: 'My Procurement Requests' timeline showing approval status.

visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px solid borders (#E5E4E0) on all cards. Remove generic drop shadows. The UI should look like a structured blueprint.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for the sticky topbar (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b). Never use on data cards.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Do not leave empty space. Use the provided aerial view image as a subtle, low-opacity background for empty states or the auth screen, overlaid with white.
visual_enhancers.status_pills: Rectangular (rounded-sm), not fully rounded. 1px border matching the text color, 10% opacity background of the text color. (e.g., text-[#9B3922] bg-[#9B3922]/10 border-[#9B3922]/20).

buttons.primary: bg-[#1A2F24] text-white rounded-sm px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-[#112119] transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-[#1A2F24]
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#1A2F24] border border-[#E5E4E0] rounded-sm px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-[#F6F6F4] transition-colors
buttons.danger: bg-[#9B3922] text-white rounded-sm px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-[#7A2D1B] transition-colors

inputs.style: w-full rounded-sm border border-[#E5E4E0] bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-[#141514] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#1A2F24] focus:border-[#1A2F24]

tables.header: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#5C5C58] border-b-2 border-[#E5E4E0] py-3 px-4

cards.style: bg-white border border-[#E5E4E0] rounded-sm flex flex-col p-6

motion.hover_states: All interactive rows and cards must have a subtle hover state. For rows: bg-[#F1F1EE]. For cards: border-[#1A2F24].
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform duration-200. NEVER use 'transition-all'.
motion.modals: Fade in with a slight upward translation (translate-y-2 to translate-y-0).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA guidelines. The #5C5C58 secondary text on #FFFFFF is 4.5:1.
accessibility.focus: All buttons and inputs must have visible focus rings (focus:ring-2).
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all buttons, links, inputs, and tab triggers.

auth_background.description: Aerial view of agricultural fields and plots. Use this for the Login page background (with a heavy overlay or positioned on one half of the screen) to ground the app in its real-estate/land domain.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace the plain white sidebar/emerald-900 look with the 'Agrocorp Precision' theme. Install 'lucide-react' for crisp iconography if not present.
2. Add Google Fonts 'Cabinet Grotesk' (or outfit/sans), 'Manrope', and 'JetBrains Mono' to index.css.
3. Overhaul the Routing structure to support 4 distinct dashboard homepages based on user role (Admin, Post-Sales, Accounts, Site Manager).
4. Refactor standard html tables to follow the high-density grid approach. Use JetBrains Mono for all numeric columns (Currency, POs, Dates).
5. Do NOT use standard Shadcn rounded-xl cards. Override all border-radii to rounded-sm (4px) and remove generic drop-shadows. Rely on 1px solid borders.
6. Build the 'Mark Sold' Modal for Post-Sales Reps with an editable payment schedule table.
7. Format all currency as INR (₹) utilizing standard local string formatting.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic SaaS defaults. Embed the 'Agrocorp' architectural persona.
Avoid centered text layouts; left-align data for scannability.
Use JetBrains Mono for data. Do NOT apply global 'transition-all'.
Ensure the Topbar is NOT transparent (use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80).
